money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 2 Jan 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed-data page, 2 Jan row); POLSTR for 2 Jan not used (published 5 Jan, T+1); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 2 Jan 2026. Funding = special O/N repo 3.65%.

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 2 Jan 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste/Santander daily of 5 Jan 2026 (table headed 02.01.2026; only the 2 Jan levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available; PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR (2 Jan) and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 2 Jan 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 2 Jan 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 2 Jan 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.23% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (OK0426 3.24%, DS0726 3.21%, PS1026 3.25%).
